part.text:
Fixed in lib/adapters/http.js:475-486. The http adapter now lower-cases the `content-encoding` response header value before the decompression switch, so encodings like `GZIP`, `GZip`, or `Br` are handled the same as their lowercase forms (also checks the `Content-Encoding` header key variant).

Validation in the testbed container:
- Full unit suite: 151 passing / 5 failing, where the 5 failures (max content length, HTTPS, DNS) are pre-existing environment issues — the baseline without the fix was 98 passing / 8 failing, so the 3 previously failing `GZIP` decompression tests now pass.
